title: 脳科学
subtitle: Brain Science
educationalGoal: Brain science is a comprehensive science in the fields of science including biology and the fields of humanities including psychology. In that sense, this subject has the role of finishing what was learned in the 1st and 2nd grades. We will study neural circuits composed of DNA, proteins, nerve cells, etc., and learn what kind of function our brain exerts and the structure of the brain that is the basis of it. As a result, we will understand the function of a large information processing system called the nervous system, that is, the higher functions of the brain.
advice: 1: How to learn brain science and its transition 2: Molecular basis for brain function (DNA and protein, etc .: review) 3: Cells that make up the brain (neurons and glia: review) 4: Brain as an input / output device 5: Memory and learning 6: Affect 7: Hearing 8: Somatosensory 9: Hormones in the brain 10: Brain diseases (dementia, etc.)
requiredKnowledge: General knowledge of neuroscience and evolution are required. In order to understand the information presented, it is necessary to regularly study the background information.

activityGoals.body: Explain cognitive bias in the human brain.
